vulnerabilityAlerts.description: The self-hosted bot disables vulnerability alerts org-wide, so each repo has to opt in to get security PRs.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Refresh yarn.lock weekly so in-range fixes for transitive deps land; Renovate only bumps what package.json declares.

packageRules.description: Do not create PRs that upgrade to prerelease versions
Do not update dependencies that are already on prerelease versions
Pin GitHub Actions to commit SHA digests to prevent supply chain attacks
Don't touch internal iomete reusable workflow refs - they intentionally track main
